label: Mission preference (C read at click time)
basis: C is read from the target mission's own text at click time, so it is a step of the click and not a vector the stack must have prepared. Code: futon2 scripts/futon2/wm/extract_outcomes.clj (the three disciplines; verify-proposed-link; extract); src/futon2/aif/served_by_reading.clj (proposal, read-link, reading: quotes to code-point spans pinned to the text sha256); src/futon2/aif/flight_runner.clj read-fn (the flight's read step). Stage PERCEIVE, not EVALUATE: the step reads text and emits cued outcomes, which WM-EQUATIONS-DELTA-D section 2.1 hosts at R2 with imports [:mission-text]; its output reaches R5 as the R2 to R5 edge carrying C, which the delta records as a theory edge the code does not yet carry. The catalogue names this the C vector and the drawing shows it as an unnumbered Preferences node (r-wr-factoring.edn:55); this row gives it the R19 id the delta uses. The C that enters risk today is still built at src/futon2/aif/cascade_problems.clj:150-174 from :want and the live-c scales, not from this step.

label: Token C_tau (per-problem lane + constructor)
basis: CTAU-I, from CTAU-D (futon3c e30a3a54, claude-2). The TOKEN C_tau family: cascade_model_manifest/preference-member builds C_tau over subsets of the problem's token universe from the cascade spec's :want and :evidence with lam and mu, under the schedule's :placement, and horizon-g-sparse* takes risk against it per tau. Consumed by the per-problem lane's R5 step (war_machine.clj:5905-5935) and the constructor's :evaluate-g (constructed-candidate-g :6065). Stage EVALUATE because the family exists to be scored against, not to be read. It is a node and an equation row (:preference-schedule): the registry needed a place for the family that is distinct from :mission-preference's READ outcomes at R19, because HOP 1 (text -> outcomes -> spec) is not wired and the two must not share a box. NOT the family the tick's joint decision scores; that is CTAU-CLASS.

label: Class C_tau (the tick's joint decision)
basis: CTAU-I, from CTAU-D. The CLASS C_tau family: war_machine/class-observation-model holds the literal {focused 55/100, related 35/100, unrelated 5/100, stop-the-line 5/100} at tau = T and unit mass on :ending/not-yet-evaluated at tau < T, and cascade_observation_scoring reads (get-in model [:class-preference tau]) -- its own comment says classes are NOT routed through preference-member. Reached by the tick's joint decision through efe.clj:1111's (contains? opts :observation-model) branch. Stage EVALUATE, beside CTAU-TOKEN, because the two are alternative scorers of the same position and the figure should show that there are two. The relation -> class -> class-model hops that feed it are VERIFIED wires of the M-wm-wiring map, not edges of this registry.

label: Grain gate (admissible-enactment support)
basis: The grain gate defines no symbol any equation imports; it restricts which enactments are admissible, the shape Clause T gives feasibility (membership in the policy support, not a term of G). Code: futon2 src/futon2/aif/grain_gate.clj:65-127 (grain-gate: first typed refusal wins among :grain-not-declared, :grain-mismatch, :scope-mismatch, :resolver-missing, :arglist-mismatch, :sha-mismatch, else :pass); box :r5-grain-gate. Stage SELECT because selection ranges over the support it restricts. Declared as a node, not an equation, per WM-EQUATIONS-DELTA-D section 4, which says a drawn box is needed for it to appear in Figure 6A.
